mapper.insert: insert into dws_daily_package_promotion(dates, project_id, product_id, product_name, channel_id, channel_name, pkg, total_cost, `exchange_rate`, change_total_cost) select ac.dates, p.project_type, p.id, p.project_name, c.channel, c.channel_name, ac.pkg, SUM(ac.cost), #{singleFee}, ROUND(SUM(ac.cost) / #{singleFee}, 8) from ads.adjust_cost ac left join sys_channel c on (ac.pkg = c.pkg) left join sys_project p on (c.project_id = p.id) where ac.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY ac.dates, p.project_type, p.id, p.project_name, c.channel, c.channel_name, ac.pkg
mapper.select: select id, dates, project_id, product_id, product_name, channel_id, channel_name, pkg, total_cost, `exchange_rate`, change_total_cost from dws_daily_package_promotion where dates = #{dates}
